the velocity profiles are decreased and the temperature profiles are increased with the increase of suction/injection and buoyancy parameters.
for a given buoyancy parameter the heat transfer rate decreases as suction increases and the heat transfer rate increases as injection increases.

the velocity profiles are increased by the increase of the suction parameter and the decrease of the buoyancy parameter, and the temperature profiles are decreased by the increase of suction parameter and the increase of buoyancy parameter.

the study of the forced and free mixed boundary layer flow of a viscous incompressible fluid on a vertical flat surface with uniform suction or uniform injection.
the laminar forced and mixed convection boundary-layer flows with uniform suction or uniform injection on a vertical surface.
the study of the forced and free mixed convective laminar flow of a viscous, incompressible, and electrically conducting fluid over a vertical flat plate with uniform injection or suction.
